subject: Align trial KPIs, evaluation plan, and request for exec readout slots
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ilyin <sasha.ilyin@virtumed.com>, Dana Park <dana.park@virtumed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: proposed POC KPIs + timeline

Thanks Sasha and Dana — good call today. Per our discussion, here’s a short written recap and the proposal for the POC run so we can align before Marcus and engineering spin up the environment. Please confirm or flag anything I missed.

High-level goal
- Validate that VirtuMed’s ingestion + Redwood inference pipeline meets latency, throughput and clinical-quality thresholds for the outpatient triage workflow.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end inference < 350ms for 512-token requests
- Throughput: sustained 5 requests/sec with <= 50ms queueing per request
- Clinical NER accuracy: F1 >= 0.85 on the annotated test set (we’ll share baseline labels)
- No PII exfiltration incidents in redacted test runs; logging/audit must be enabled

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): confirm datasets, sign SSO access + staging IP allowlist, share SOW draft
- Week 1: smoke tests and connectivity (owner: Marcus)
- Weeks 2–3: accuracy runs, edge-case sampling, latency/load tests (owners: VirtuMed data team + Marcus)
- Week 4: internal readout + exec readout prep; request exec slot the week of Nov 8–12

Ownership / next steps
- VirtuMed: provide annotated sample (10k tokens) + procurement contact (Dana?)
- Redwood: provide staging endpoint, evaluation scripts, and success criteria sheet (attached)
- Monica: will coordinate contracting timeline and SOW updates

Attachments: VirtuMed_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (success criteria workbook)

Can you confirm the success criteria above and two available windows for an exec readout the week of Nov 8? If procurement needs any additional paperwork, loop Monica.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sasha Ilyin <sasha.ilyin@virtumed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Park <dana.park@virtumed.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: proposed POC KPIs + timeline

Thanks Olga — this looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. Quick notes:
- We can commit to providing the annotated sample by end of day Friday (Nov 6).
- The clinical team is comfortable with the F1 target but would like to track precision and recall separately during the run.
- Compliance ask: we need staging IPs and SSO/SAML guidance to kick off testing. Also whether logs can be retained for 30 days in our environment for audit.

For exec availability, our VP of Product can do Nov 9 (Tue) 10–11am PT or Nov 11 (Thu) 2–3pm PT. Let us know which you prefer.

Sasha Ilyin
Head of AI
VirtuMed Health

Great — adding technical specifics and the artifacts we’ll drop into staging. Sasha, I’ll own the smoke/connectivity and the load tests. Notes below:

Artifacts/files we attached:
- VirtuMed_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (detailed KPI workbook and measurement scripts)
- SOW_Draft_20261104.pdf (scope, milestones, and contracting runway)

Staging details / access
- Staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood.virtumed/ (pre-auth; we’ll add SSO config once we have metadata)
- SSO: SAML 2.0 supported. Marcus will send a short metadata template and ACS URL by EOD Nov 3.
- Allowlist: please provide the CIDR blocks for your test agents; we’ll add to firewall.

Evaluation scripts (examples)
- run_eval.sh --data samples/virtumed_testset.jsonl --model redwood-llama-70b --metrics ner,precision,recall,f1 --output results/virtumed_run_1.json
- curl example to hit streaming endpoint included in attachment notes

Runtime recommendations
- Start with batch size 4, dynamic KV cache enabled, quantization profile "q8_0" for balanced latency/cost.
- If you see p95 spikes above 350ms, reduce batch to 2 or enable the low-latency routing policy.

I’ll upload the evaluation container and put the S3 paths inside the workbook. Monica — see SOW notes where I added a two-week optional extension for follow-up remediation.

Attachment stubs: VirtuMed_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (xlsx), SOW_Draft_20261104.pdf (pdf)

Marcus Lin

Subject: Requesting exec readout slot + decision process and contracting runway

Quick follow-up and logistics so we can lock the calendar and contracting path.

Proposed exec readout
- Options: Nov 9 Tue 10–11am PT or Nov 11 Thu 2–3pm PT (per Sasha’s availability). Please confirm which slot works for your execs; we will block Nov 9 as tentative until we hear back.

Who should attend from our side
- Olga Petrov (AE) — commercial context and decision framing
- Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng) — technical readout and test results walkthrough
- Monica Patel (Contracts Lead) — contracting timeline and SOW questions

Decision cadence
- Goal: decision within 48 hours of exec readout (go/no-go), with contracting to start immediately (Monica will draft the initial SOW and a short-term reserved-capacity proposal).
- If execs need an extra technical deep-dive, we can schedule a 30–45 minute follow-up within 3 business days.

Procurement & compliance asks
- Sasha/Dana: if procurement requires a specific contract template or additional attestation (SOC2 enumeration, DPA clauses), send to monica.patel@redwood.com and I’ll triage.
- On logs: Marcus confirms we can retain 30-day logs in your staging environment; we will redacted PII during runs.

Next actions
- Sasha: confirm exec slot and procurement contact (if different from Dana)
- Dana: share CIDR blocks + annotated sample by EOD Nov 6
- Marcus: will send SAML metadata template and upload evaluation container by EOD Nov 3 (in progress)

Thanks — looking forward to the readout.

Monica Patel
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
